items.question: Trong câu "CI (topic 13) ends with a tested, versioned artifact in a registry.", từ "versioned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI (topic 13) ends with a tested, versioned artifact in a registry.", what does "versioned" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: versioned /ˈvɜːʃənd/ (tính từ): được gắn số phiên bản. Một artifact "versioned" có số phiên bản rõ ràng để truy vết và triển khai lại.
items.explanationEn: versioned /ˈvɜːʃənd/ (adjective): labelled with a version number. A versioned artifact carries a clear version number so it can be traced and redeployed.

items.question: Trong câu "CI (topic 13) ends with a tested, versioned artifact in a registry.", từ "registry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI (topic 13) ends with a tested, versioned artifact in a registry.", what does "registry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: registry /ˈredʒɪstri/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ tập trung. Hay gặp trong "container registry", "package registry" — nơi lưu image hoặc gói phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: registry /ˈredʒɪstri/ (noun): a central store of items. Common in "container registry" and "package registry", where images or packages are stored.

items.question: Trong câu "The abbreviation hides two practices", từ "abbreviation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The abbreviation hides two practices", what does "abbreviation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a shortened form of a word
a note added to a text
items.explanation: abbreviation /əˌbriːviˈeɪʃn/ (danh từ): chữ viết tắt. "CD" là chữ viết tắt có thể hiểu theo hai nghĩa: delivery hoặc deployment.
items.explanationEn: abbreviation /əˌbriːviˈeɪʃn/ (noun): a shortened form of a word. "CD" is an abbreviation that can stand for either delivery or deployment.

items.question: Trong câu "Second distinction: deploy ≠ release.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Second distinction: deploy ≠ release.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋkʃn/ (danh từ): sự phân biệt. Cụm "make/draw a distinction between A and B" = phân biệt A với B.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋkʃn/ (noun): a clear difference. "Make/draw a distinction between A and B" means to show how A and B differ.

items.question: Trong câu "exposes behaviour to users. Separating them (dark launches, feature flags) is what makes frequent deploys low-risk.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "exposes behaviour to users. Separating them (dark launches, feature flags) is what makes frequent deploys low-risk.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): đưa ra, làm lộ ra. "Expose something to users" = đưa tính năng tới tay người dùng; "expose an API" = mở API ra ngoài.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make visible or available. "Expose something to users" means making it reachable by them; "expose an API" means making it available.

items.question: Trong câu "Golden rule: build once, promote the same artifact.", từ "promote" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Golden rule: build once, promote the same artifact.", what does "promote" (verb) mean?
options: đẩy lên môi trường kế tiếp
optionsEn: to move to the next stage
items.explanation: promote /prəˈməʊt/ (động từ): đẩy lên môi trường kế tiếp. Trong CD, "promote" là chuyển cùng một artifact từ dev → staging → production.
items.explanationEn: promote /prəˈməʊt/ (verb): to move to the next stage. In CD, to promote is to move the same artifact from dev to staging to production.

items.question: Trong câu "Production runs the exact image digest that was tested, never a rebuild.", từ "digest" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Production runs the exact image digest that was tested, never a rebuild.", what does "digest" (noun) mean?
options: mã băm định danh nội dung
items.explanation: digest /ˈdaɪdʒest/ (danh từ): mã băm định danh nội dung. Image digest (sha256:...) không đổi, khác với tag có thể bị gán lại.
items.explanationEn: digest /ˈdaɪdʒest/ (noun): a hash identifying content. An image digest (sha256:...) never changes, unlike a tag that can be reassigned.

items.question: Trong câu "What changes between environments is configuration (URLs, credentials, replica counts), injected at deploy time from env vars, ConfigMaps or a secrets manager.", từ "inject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What changes between environments is configuration (URLs, credentials, replica counts), injected at deploy time from env vars, ConfigMaps or a secrets manager.", what does "inject" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a drug in with a needle
items.explanation: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (động từ): đưa vào từ bên ngoài. "Inject configuration/dependencies" = cấp cấu hình hoặc phụ thuộc vào ứng dụng lúc chạy.
items.explanationEn: inject /ɪnˈdʒekt/ (verb): to supply from outside. "Inject configuration/dependencies" means providing them to the application at run time.

items.question: Trong câu "What changes between environments is configuration (URLs, credentials, replica counts), injected at deploy time from env vars, ConfigMaps or a secrets manager.", từ "credential" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What changes between environments is configuration (URLs, credentials, replica counts), injected at deploy time from env vars, ConfigMaps or a secrets manager.", what does "credential" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credential /krəˈdenʃl/ (danh từ): thông tin xác thực. Thường dùng số nhiều "credentials": mật khẩu, khóa API, token.
items.explanationEn: credential /krəˈdenʃl/ (noun): secret data proving identity. Usually plural, "credentials": passwords, API keys and tokens.

items.question: Trong câu "Promotion gates: automated (smoke tests, error-rate checks, scan results) and manual (e.g. a GitHub Actions environment: production with required reviewers).", từ "gate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Promotion gates: automated (smoke tests, error-rate checks, scan results) and manual (e.g. a GitHub Actions environment: production with required reviewers).", what does "gate" (noun) mean?
options: chốt kiểm soát phải vượt qua
optionsEn: a hinged opening in a fence
a checkpoint that must be passed
items.explanation: gate /ɡeɪt/ (danh từ): chốt kiểm soát phải vượt qua. "Quality gate" = điều kiện chất lượng mà thay đổi phải đạt trước khi đi tiếp.
items.explanationEn: gate /ɡeɪt/ (noun): a checkpoint that must be passed. A "quality gate" is a condition a change must meet before moving on.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequent deploy freezes are a smell that deploys are too risky.", từ "freeze" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequent deploy freezes are a smell that deploys are too risky.", what does "freeze" (noun) mean?
options: giai đoạn tạm ngừng thay đổi
optionsEn: a period when changes are halted
the process of turning to ice
items.explanation: freeze /friːz/ (danh từ): giai đoạn tạm ngừng thay đổi. "Code freeze"/"deploy freeze" = khoảng thời gian cấm đưa thay đổi lên.
items.explanationEn: freeze /friːz/ (noun): a period when changes are halted. A "code freeze" or "deploy freeze" is a time when no changes may be shipped.

items.question: Trong câu "Frequent deploy freezes are a smell that deploys are too risky.", từ "smell" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Frequent deploy freezes are a smell that deploys are too risky.", what does "smell" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an odour noticed by the nose
a sign that something is wrong
items.explanation: smell /smel/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu có vấn đề. "Code smell" = dấu hiệu trong mã cho thấy thiết kế có thể đang có vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: smell /smel/ (noun): a sign that something is wrong. A "code smell" is a hint in code that the design may have a deeper problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Staging never matches production (data volume, traffic shape, third parties).", từ "match" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Staging never matches production (data volume, traffic shape, third parties).", what does "match" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: match /mætʃ/ (động từ): giống, khớp với. "A matches B" = A giống hệt B; staging không bao giờ giống hoàn toàn production.
items.explanationEn: match /mætʃ/ (verb): to be the same as. "A matches B" means A is the same as B; staging is never identical to production.

items.question: Trong câu "Old and new never coexist, but there is guaranteed downtime.", từ "coexist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Old and new never coexist, but there is guaranteed downtime.", what does "coexist" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to exist at the same time
items.explanation: coexist /ˌkəʊɪɡˈzɪst/ (động từ): cùng tồn tại. "Coexist with something" = tồn tại song song cùng cái gì đó.
items.explanationEn: coexist /ˌkəʊɪɡˈzɪst/ (verb): to exist at the same time. "Coexist with something" means to exist alongside it.

items.question: Trong câu "Old and new never coexist, but there is guaranteed downtime.", từ "guaranteed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Old and new never coexist, but there is guaranteed downtime.", what does "guaranteed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: guaranteed /ˌɡærənˈtiːd/ (tính từ): chắc chắn xảy ra. Với chiến lược Recreate, downtime là điều chắc chắn.
items.explanationEn: guaranteed /ˌɡærənˈtiːd/ (adjective): certain to happen. With the Recreate strategy, downtime is certain.

items.question: Trong câu "Old and new never coexist, but there is guaranteed downtime.", từ "downtime" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Old and new never coexist, but there is guaranteed downtime.", what does "downtime" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: downtime /ˈdaʊntaɪm/ (danh từ): thời gian ngừng hoạt động. "Zero downtime" = không có lúc nào hệ thống ngừng phục vụ.
items.explanationEn: downtime /ˈdaʊntaɪm/ (noun): time a system is unavailable. "Zero downtime" means the system is never unavailable.

items.question: Trong câu "Fine for dev, batch workers, or versions that truly cannot run side by side.", từ "side by side" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fine for dev, batch workers, or versions that truly cannot run side by side.", what does "side by side" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: side by side /ˌsaɪd baɪ ˈsaɪd/ (cụm từ): song song cạnh nhau. "Run side by side" = hai phiên bản cùng chạy đồng thời.
items.explanationEn: side by side /ˌsaɪd baɪ ˈsaɪd/ (phrase): together at the same time. "Run side by side" means two versions run at the same time.

items.question: Trong câu "No extra capacity (only maxSurge) and no downtime", từ "capacity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No extra capacity (only maxSurge) and no downtime", what does "capacity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the speed of a network link
items.explanation: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (danh từ): lượng tài nguyên sẵn có. "Extra capacity" = thêm máy chủ/pod ngoài số lượng bình thường.
items.explanationEn: capacity /kəˈpæsəti/ (noun): the amount of resources available. "Extra capacity" means servers or pods beyond the normal amount.

items.question: Trong câu "Both versions serve traffic at once, so v2 must be compatible with v1 (APIs, message formats, DB schema).", từ "compatible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both versions serve traffic at once, so v2 must be compatible with v1 (APIs, message formats, DB schema).", what does "compatible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: compatible /kəmˈpætəbl/ (tính từ): tương thích. "Backward compatible" = phiên bản mới vẫn làm việc được với phiên bản cũ.
items.explanationEn: compatible /kəmˈpætəbl/ (adjective): able to work together. "Backward compatible" means a new version still works with the old one.

items.question: Trong câu "Both versions serve traffic at once, so v2 must be compatible with v1 (APIs, message formats, DB schema).", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both versions serve traffic at once, so v2 must be compatible with v1 (APIs, message formats, DB schema).", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At once" có hai nghĩa: "đồng thời" (như trong câu này) và "ngay lập tức".
items.explanationEn: at once /ət ˈwʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "At once" has two senses: "simultaneously" (as here) and "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "Blue stays warm for instant rollback.", từ "warm" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Blue stays warm for instant rollback.", what does "warm" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: warm /wɔːm/ (tính từ): vẫn chạy và sẵn sàng. "Warm standby" = môi trường dự phòng vẫn đang chạy, chuyển sang được ngay.
items.explanationEn: warm /wɔːm/ (adjective): running and ready to use. A "warm standby" is a backup environment kept running so you can switch at once.

items.question: Trong câu "Blue stays warm for instant rollback.", từ "instant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Blue stays warm for instant rollback.", what does "instant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: instant /ˈɪnstənt/ (tính từ): tức thì. "Instant rollback" = quay lại phiên bản cũ gần như ngay lập tức.
items.explanationEn: instant /ˈɪnstənt/ (adjective): happening immediately. "Instant rollback" means returning to the old version almost immediately.

items.question: Trong câu "A DNS switch is slow and unreliable because resolvers and clients cache records and some ignore the TTL.", từ "unreliable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A DNS switch is slow and unreliable because resolvers and clients cache records and some ignore the TTL.", what does "unreliable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreliable /ˌʌnrɪˈlaɪəbl/ (tính từ): không đáng tin cậy. Trái nghĩa: "reliable" (đáng tin cậy); danh từ "reliability".
items.explanationEn: unreliable /ˌʌnrɪˈlaɪəbl/ (adjective): not able to be trusted. Opposite: "reliable"; the noun is "reliability".

items.question: Trong câu "A DNS switch is slow and unreliable because resolvers and clients cache records and some ignore the TTL.", từ "ignore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A DNS switch is slow and unreliable because resolvers and clients cache records and some ignore the TTL.", what does "ignore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔː(r)/ (động từ): phớt lờ, bỏ qua. Một số client bỏ qua TTL nên vẫn dùng bản ghi DNS cũ.
items.explanationEn: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔː(r)/ (verb): to pay no attention to. Some clients ignore the TTL and keep using the old DNS record.

items.question: Trong câu "The hard parts: the database is usually shared, so the schema must suit both versions (section 8); in-flight requests and WebSockets must drain; sessions must live outside instances.", từ "drain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The hard parts: the database is usually shared, so the schema must suit both versions (section 8); in-flight requests and WebSockets must drain; sessions must live outside instances.", what does "drain" (verb) mean?
options: xử lý hết rồi mới dừng
items.explanation: drain /dreɪn/ (động từ): xử lý hết rồi mới dừng. "Connection draining" = ngừng nhận kết nối mới và chờ các kết nối đang có kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: drain /dreɪn/ (verb): to finish until none remain. "Connection draining" means taking no new connections and letting current ones finish.

items.question: Trong câu "The hard parts: the database is usually shared, so the schema must suit both versions (section 8); in-flight requests and WebSockets must drain; sessions must live outside instances.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The hard parts: the database is usually shared, so the schema must suit both versions (section 8); in-flight requests and WebSockets must drain; sessions must live outside instances.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "Suit someone/something" = hợp với ai/cái gì; tính từ "suitable".
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "Suit someone/something" means to be right for them; the adjective is "suitable".

items.question: Trong câu "A canary sends a small slice of real traffic to v2, compares metrics, and raises the share step by step — or aborts.", từ "slice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A canary sends a small slice of real traffic to v2, compares metrics, and raises the share step by step — or aborts.", what does "slice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (danh từ): một phần nhỏ. "A slice of traffic" = một phần lưu lượng, giống "một lát" của cái bánh.
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (noun): a portion of a whole. "A slice of traffic" is a portion of it, like a slice of a cake.

items.question: Trong câu "A canary sends a small slice of real traffic to v2, compares metrics, and raises the share step by step — or aborts.", từ "step by step" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A canary sends a small slice of real traffic to v2, compares metrics, and raises the share step by step — or aborts.", what does "step by step" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: step by step /ˌstep baɪ ˈstep/ (cụm từ): từng bước một. Canary tăng tỷ lệ theo từng bước: 5% → 25% → 50% → 100%.
items.explanationEn: step by step /ˌstep baɪ ˈstep/ (phrase): gradually, in stages. A canary raises its share in stages: 5%, 25%, 50%, then 100%.

items.question: Trong câu "A canary sends a small slice of real traffic to v2, compares metrics, and raises the share step by step — or aborts.", từ "abort" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A canary sends a small slice of real traffic to v2, compares metrics, and raises the share step by step — or aborts.", what does "abort" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: abort /əˈbɔːt/ (động từ): hủy giữa chừng. "Abort a rollout/transaction" = hủy tiến trình đang chạy khi có lỗi.
items.explanationEn: abort /əˈbɔːt/ (verb): to stop before finishing. "Abort a rollout/transaction" means cancelling it while it runs, usually on failure.

items.question: Trong câu "It limits the blast radius: a bad release hurts 5% of users for ten minutes, not everyone.", từ "blast radius" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It limits the blast radius: a bad release hurts 5% of users for ten minutes, not everyone.", what does "blast radius" (phrase) mean?
options: phạm vi ảnh hưởng khi lỗi
optionsEn: the reach of damage from a failure
the area hit by an explosion
items.explanation: blast radius /ˈblɑːst ˌreɪdiəs/ (cụm từ): phạm vi ảnh hưởng khi lỗi. "Limit/reduce the blast radius" = thu hẹp số người hoặc hệ thống bị ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: blast radius /ˈblɑːst ˌreɪdiəs/ (phrase): the reach of damage from a failure. "Limit/reduce the blast radius" means shrinking how many users or systems are affected.

items.question: Trong câu "Progressive delivery automates it: a controller shifts weights and runs metric analysis.", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Progressive delivery automates it: a controller shifts weights and runs metric analysis.", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): dịch chuyển, thay đổi. "Shift traffic" = chuyển dần lưu lượng từ phiên bản này sang phiên bản khác.
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to move or change. "Shift traffic" means moving traffic from one version to another.

items.question: Trong câu "Split precision — without a mesh or smart ingress, weight is approximated by pod count (1 of 10 pods ≈ 10%).", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Split precision — without a mesh or smart ingress, weight is approximated by pod count (1 of 10 pods ≈ 10%).", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒn/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. Tính từ "precise" = chính xác; "high precision" = độ chính xác cao.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒn/ (noun): exactness. The adjective is "precise"; "high precision" means very exact.

items.question: Trong câu "Split precision — without a mesh or smart ingress, weight is approximated by pod count (1 of 10 pods ≈ 10%).", từ "approximate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Split precision — without a mesh or smart ingress, weight is approximated by pod count (1 of 10 pods ≈ 10%).", what does "approximate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approximate /əˈprɒksɪmeɪt/ (động từ): ước tính gần đúng. Là tính từ, "approximate" /-mət/ = xấp xỉ; trạng từ "approximately".
items.explanationEn: approximate /əˈprɒksɪmeɪt/ (verb): to estimate roughly. As an adjective, "approximate" /-mət/ means roughly correct; the adverb is "approximately".

items.question: Trong câu "Low traffic breaks canaries — 5% of 20 requests/minute is one request; no signal.", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Low traffic breaks canaries — 5% of 20 requests/minute is one request; no signal.", what does "signal" (noun) mean?
options: dữ liệu đủ để kết luận
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (danh từ): dữ liệu đủ để kết luận. "Signal vs noise" = thông tin có ý nghĩa so với dao động ngẫu nhiên.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (noun): information enough to judge by. "Signal vs noise" contrasts meaningful information with random variation.

items.question: Trong câu "Stickiness — route by user when bouncing between versions would confuse users.", từ "confuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stickiness — route by user when bouncing between versions would confuse users.", what does "confuse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to cause data to be lost
items.explanation: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (động từ): làm bối rối. "Confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B; danh từ "confusion".
items.explanationEn: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (verb): to make someone puzzled. "Confuse A with B" means mistaking A for B; the noun is "confusion".

items.question: Trong câu "Compare against a baseline running v1 at the same time, not yesterday's numbers.", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compare against a baseline running v1 at the same time, not yesterday's numbers.", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the back line of a sports court
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (danh từ): mốc đối chứng. "Compare against a baseline" = so sánh với mức chuẩn để thấy khác biệt.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (noun): a reference point for comparison. "Compare against a baseline" means measuring change relative to a reference.

items.question: Trong câu "Shadow deployment (traffic mirroring): requests are copied to v2 and its responses discarded; users only see v1's answer.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shadow deployment (traffic mirroring): requests are copied to v2 and its responses discarded; users only see v1's answer.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. Trong shadow deployment, phản hồi của v2 bị bỏ đi, người dùng không thấy.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. In a shadow deployment, v2's responses are thrown away and never reach users.

items.question: Trong câu "The trap is side effects: a mirrored POST /payments charges twice and mirrored requests send emails.", từ "side effect" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trap is side effects: a mirrored POST /payments charges twice and mirrored requests send emails.", what does "side effect" (phrase) mean?
options: tác động phụ ngoài ý muốn
items.explanation: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (cụm từ): tác động phụ ngoài ý muốn. Trong lập trình, side effect là thay đổi bên ngoài hàm: ghi DB, gửi email, trừ tiền.
items.explanationEn: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (phrase): an unintended extra result. In programming, a side effect is a change outside the code itself: a DB write, an email, a charge.

items.question: Trong câu "The trap is side effects: a mirrored POST /payments charges twice and mirrored requests send emails.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trap is side effects: a mirrored POST /payments charges twice and mirrored requests send emails.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
options: cái bẫy, chỗ dễ mắc lỗi
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy, chỗ dễ mắc lỗi. "Fall into the trap of..." = mắc phải sai lầm dễ gặp.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a hidden danger. "Fall into the trap of..." means making an easy, common mistake.

items.question: Trong câu "It also doubles load on shared dependencies.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It also doubles load on shared dependencies.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
options: thành phần hệ thống phụ thuộc
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): thành phần hệ thống phụ thuộc. "Shared dependencies" = các dịch vụ dùng chung như DB, cache, API bên thứ ba.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): something a system relies on. "Shared dependencies" are common services such as databases, caches and third-party APIs.

items.question: Trong câu "A feature flag is a runtime condition, evaluated per request, user or tenant, that turns a code path on or off.", từ "evaluate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A feature flag is a runtime condition, evaluated per request, user or tenant, that turns a code path on or off.", what does "evaluate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work out the value of
items.explanation: evaluate /ɪˈvæljueɪt/ (động từ): tính ra giá trị. "Evaluate an expression/condition" = tính ra kết quả đúng/sai hoặc giá trị.
items.explanationEn: evaluate /ɪˈvæljueɪt/ (verb): to work out the value of. "Evaluate an expression/condition" means working out its result.

items.question: Trong câu "A feature flag is a runtime condition, evaluated per request, user or tenant, that turns a code path on or off.", từ "tenant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A feature flag is a runtime condition, evaluated per request, user or tenant, that turns a code path on or off.", what does "tenant" (noun) mean?
options: khách hàng dùng chung hệ thống
items.explanation: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (danh từ): khách hàng dùng chung hệ thống. "Multi-tenant" = nhiều khách hàng (tổ chức) dùng chung một hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: tenant /ˈtenənt/ (noun): a customer sharing a system. "Multi-tenant" means many customer organisations share one system.

items.question: Trong câu "Code ships dark and is enabled gradually without a deploy.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Code ships dark and is enabled gradually without a deploy.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): được phát hành. "Ship a feature" = đưa tính năng ra sản phẩm; "ship dark" = phát hành nhưng đang tắt.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to be released. "Ship a feature" means releasing it; "ship dark" means releasing it switched off.

items.question: Trong câu "Code ships dark and is enabled gradually without a deploy.", từ "gradually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Code ships dark and is enabled gradually without a deploy.", what does "gradually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: gradually /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ (trạng từ): dần dần. Tính từ "gradual"; "a gradual rollout" = triển khai dần dần.
items.explanationEn: gradually /ˈɡrædʒuəli/ (adverb): slowly, in small steps. The adjective is "gradual"; "a gradual rollout" happens in small steps.

items.question: Trong câu "stale flags are risky dead code", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "stale flags are risky dead code", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): cũ, không còn dùng. "Stale data/cache" = dữ liệu cũ, không còn cập nhật.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): old and no longer useful. "Stale data/cache" means data that is out of date.

items.question: Trong câu "so give each release flag an owner and expiry", từ "expiry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so give each release flag an owner and expiry", what does "expiry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪəri/ (danh từ): thời hạn hết hiệu lực. "Expiry date" = ngày hết hạn; động từ "expire".
items.explanationEn: expiry /ɪkˈspaɪəri/ (noun): the date something ends. "Expiry date" is the date something ends; the verb is "expire".

items.question: Trong câu "evaluate locally with safe defaults so a flag-service outage does not become yours.", từ "outage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "evaluate locally with safe defaults so a flag-service outage does not become yours.", what does "outage" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a planned upgrade of a service
a period when a service is down
items.explanation: outage /ˈaʊtɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự cố ngừng dịch vụ. "Power outage" = mất điện; "service outage" = dịch vụ ngừng hoạt động.
items.explanationEn: outage /ˈaʊtɪdʒ/ (noun): a period when a service is down. A "power outage" is a loss of electricity; a "service outage" is a service being down.

items.question: Trong câu "OpenFeature (CNCF) is the vendor-neutral API used above.", từ "vendor-neutral" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OpenFeature (CNCF) is the vendor-neutral API used above.", what does "vendor-neutral" (adjective) mean?
options: không gắn với nhà cung cấp nào
optionsEn: not tied to any one supplier
items.explanation: vendor-neutral /ˌvendə ˈnjuːtrəl/ (tính từ): không gắn với nhà cung cấp nào. API trung lập với nhà cung cấp giúp tránh "vendor lock-in" (bị khóa chặt vào một hãng).
items.explanationEn: vendor-neutral /ˌvendə ˈnjuːtrəl/ (adjective): not tied to any one supplier. A vendor-neutral API helps avoid "vendor lock-in".

items.question: Trong câu "Use expand–contract (parallel change).", từ "parallel" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use expand–contract (parallel change).", what does "parallel" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: parallel /ˈpærəlel/ (tính từ): song song. "Parallel change" = chạy cấu trúc cũ và mới song song trong lúc chuyển đổi.
items.explanationEn: parallel /ˈpærəlel/ (adjective): happening alongside. "Parallel change" keeps the old and new structures side by side during the move.

items.question: Trong câu "During rolling, blue-green or canary deploys, two app versions share one database, so every schema change must work for both.", từ "schema" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During rolling, blue-green or canary deploys, two app versions share one database, so every schema change must work for both.", what does "schema" (noun) mean?
options: lược đồ cấu trúc dữ liệu
items.explanation: schema /ˈskiːmə/ (danh từ): lược đồ cấu trúc dữ liệu. "Schema change/migration" = thay đổi bảng, cột, chỉ mục của cơ sở dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: schema /ˈskiːmə/ (noun): the structure of a database. A "schema change/migration" alters tables, columns or indexes.

items.question: Trong câu "Additive migrations deploy before the code that needs them; destructive ones (drop, rename, add NOT NULL) after old code is gone.", từ "additive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Additive migrations deploy before the code that needs them; destructive ones (drop, rename, add NOT NULL) after old code is gone.", what does "additive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: additive /ˈædətɪv/ (tính từ): chỉ thêm, không xóa. Thay đổi "additive" (thêm cột, thêm bảng) an toàn cho cả phiên bản cũ.
items.explanationEn: additive /ˈædətɪv/ (adjective): only adding, not removing. Additive changes (new columns or tables) are safe for the old version too.

items.question: Trong câu "Additive migrations deploy before the code that needs them; destructive ones (drop, rename, add NOT NULL) after old code is gone.", từ "destructive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Additive migrations deploy before the code that needs them; destructive ones (drop, rename, add NOT NULL) after old code is gone.", what does "destructive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: destructive /dɪˈstrʌktɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính phá hủy. Thay đổi "destructive" (xóa, đổi tên cột) chỉ làm khi code cũ đã hết chạy.
items.explanationEn: destructive /dɪˈstrʌktɪv/ (adjective): removing or damaging. Destructive changes (drop, rename) wait until old code no longer runs.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch locks: a table rewrite blocks writes.", từ "lock" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch locks: a table rewrite blocks writes.", what does "lock" (noun) mean?
options: khóa chặn truy cập đồng thời
optionsEn: a device that fastens a door
items.explanation: lock /lɒk/ (danh từ): khóa chặn truy cập đồng thời. "Acquire/hold a lock" = giành/giữ khóa; khóa bảng lâu sẽ chặn các lệnh ghi khác.
items.explanationEn: lock /lɒk/ (noun): a guard against simultaneous access. "Acquire/hold a lock" means taking or keeping it; long table locks block other writes.

items.question: Trong câu "Run migrations (Flyway, Liquibase, framework tools) once as a pipeline step or Kubernetes Job, not from every replica at startup.", từ "replica" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Run migrations (Flyway, Liquibase, framework tools) once as a pipeline step or Kubernetes Job, not from every replica at startup.", what does "replica" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a model copy of an artwork
items.explanation: replica /ˈreplɪkə/ (danh từ): bản sao đang chạy. "Replica count" = số bản sao của ứng dụng đang chạy; động từ "replicate".
items.explanationEn: replica /ˈreplɪkə/ (noun): an identical running copy. "Replica count" is the number of running copies; the verb is "replicate".

items.question: Trong câu "Redeploying code cannot undo: destructive schema changes, data written in a new format, payments and emails already sent, messages already consumed by other services.", từ "undo" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Redeploying code cannot undo: destructive schema changes, data written in a new format, payments and emails already sent, messages already consumed by other services.", what does "undo" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: undo /ʌnˈduː/ (động từ): hoàn tác. "Undo a change" = đảo ngược thay đổi; nhiều hiệu ứng như email đã gửi thì không hoàn tác được.
items.explanationEn: undo /ʌnˈduː/ (verb): to reverse an action. "Undo a change" means reversing it; effects like sent emails cannot be undone.

items.question: Trong câu "Redeploying code cannot undo: destructive schema changes, data written in a new format, payments and emails already sent, messages already consumed by other services.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Redeploying code cannot undo: destructive schema changes, data written in a new format, payments and emails already sent, messages already consumed by other services.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (động từ): nhận và xử lý. "Consume messages" = đọc và xử lý thông điệp từ hàng đợi; người làm việc đó là "consumer".
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ (verb): to receive and process. "Consume messages" means reading and processing them from a queue; the reader is a "consumer".

items.question: Trong câu "A sound strategy: define rollback triggers in advance (e.g. error rate 2× baseline for 5 minutes) and automate them", từ "sound" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sound strategy: define rollback triggers in advance (e.g. error rate 2× baseline for 5 minutes) and automate them", what does "sound" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sound /saʊnd/ (tính từ): vững chắc, hợp lý. "A sound decision/approach" = quyết định/cách làm có cơ sở vững chắc.
items.explanationEn: sound /saʊnd/ (adjective): reliable and sensible. "A sound decision/approach" is one based on good judgement.

items.question: Trong câu "A sound strategy: define rollback triggers in advance (e.g. error rate 2× baseline for 5 minutes) and automate them", từ "trigger" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A sound strategy: define rollback triggers in advance (e.g. error rate 2× baseline for 5 minutes) and automate them", what does "trigger" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the lever that fires a gun
a condition that starts an action
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə(r)/ (danh từ): điều kiện kích hoạt. Cũng là động từ: "trigger a rollback" = kích hoạt việc quay lui.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə(r)/ (noun): a condition that starts an action. Also a verb: "trigger a rollback" means to start one.

items.question: Trong câu "rehearse rollback; restore service first, find the root cause later.", từ "rehearse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "rehearse rollback; restore service first, find the root cause later.", what does "rehearse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rehearse /rɪˈhɜːs/ (động từ): diễn tập. Danh từ "rehearsal"; diễn tập rollback để chắc chắn nó chạy được khi cần.
items.explanationEn: rehearse /rɪˈhɜːs/ (verb): to practise beforehand. The noun is "rehearsal"; rehearsing rollback proves it works when needed.

items.question: Trong câu "rehearse rollback; restore service first, find the root cause later.", từ "restore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "rehearse rollback; restore service first, find the root cause later.", what does "restore" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring back to working order
items.explanation: restore /rɪˈstɔː(r)/ (động từ): khôi phục. "Restore service" = đưa dịch vụ hoạt động lại; "restore from backup" = khôi phục từ bản sao lưu.
items.explanationEn: restore /rɪˈstɔː(r)/ (verb): to bring back to working order. "Restore service" means getting it working again; "restore from backup" means recovering data.

items.question: Trong câu "rehearse rollback; restore service first, find the root cause later.", từ "root cause" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "rehearse rollback; restore service first, find the root cause later.", what does "root cause" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: root cause /ˌruːt ˈkɔːz/ (cụm từ): nguyên nhân gốc rễ. "Root cause analysis" (RCA) = phân tích tìm nguyên nhân gốc của sự cố.
items.explanationEn: root cause /ˌruːt ˈkɔːz/ (phrase): the underlying reason. "Root cause analysis" (RCA) finds the underlying reason for an incident.

items.question: Trong câu "GitOps: the desired state of each environment is declared in Git, and an agent inside the cluster continuously makes reality match it.", từ "declare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "GitOps: the desired state of each environment is declared in Git, and an agent inside the cluster continuously makes reality match it.", what does "declare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: declare /dɪˈkleə(r)/ (động từ): khai báo. Tính từ "declarative" = mô tả trạng thái mong muốn thay vì từng bước thực hiện.
items.explanationEn: declare /dɪˈkleə(r)/ (verb): to state formally. The adjective "declarative" means describing the desired state rather than steps.

items.question: Trong câu "OpenGitOps principles: declarative, versioned and immutable, pulled automatically, continuously reconciled.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OpenGitOps principles: declarative, versioned and immutable, pulled automatically, continuously reconciled.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (tính từ): không thể thay đổi. Trái nghĩa: "mutable"; "immutable infrastructure" = thay mới thay vì sửa tại chỗ.
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. Opposite: "mutable"; "immutable infrastructure" is replaced, not patched in place.

items.question: Trong câu "OpenGitOps principles: declarative, versioned and immutable, pulled automatically, continuously reconciled.", từ "reconcile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OpenGitOps principles: declarative, versioned and immutable, pulled automatically, continuously reconciled.", what does "reconcile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconcile /ˈrekənsaɪl/ (động từ): làm cho khớp nhau. "Reconciliation loop" = vòng lặp liên tục đưa trạng thái thực tế về trạng thái mong muốn.
items.explanationEn: reconcile /ˈrekənsaɪl/ (verb): to make two states agree. A "reconciliation loop" keeps bringing the actual state back to the desired state.

items.question: Trong câu "Security — CI needs no cluster credentials; the cluster API need not be reachable from CI.", từ "reachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security — CI needs no cluster credentials; the cluster API need not be reachable from CI.", what does "reachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): có thể kết nối tới. "Reachable from X" = có thể truy cập qua mạng từ X; trái nghĩa "unreachable".
items.explanationEn: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): able to be accessed. "Reachable from X" means accessible over the network from X; opposite "unreachable".

items.question: Trong câu "Drift correction — a manual kubectl edit is detected and reverted.", từ "drift" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drift correction — a manual kubectl edit is detected and reverted.", what does "drift" (noun) mean?
options: sự lệch khỏi trạng thái chuẩn
optionsEn: the copying of data to another place
the shrinking of data to save space
a move away from the intended state
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (danh từ): sự lệch khỏi trạng thái chuẩn. "Configuration drift" = cấu hình thực tế dần khác với cấu hình đã khai báo.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (noun): a move away from the intended state. "Configuration drift" is when real settings slowly differ from the declared ones.

items.question: Trong câu "Drift correction — a manual kubectl edit is detected and reverted.", từ "revert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drift correction — a manual kubectl edit is detected and reverted.", what does "revert" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to return to a previous state
items.explanation: revert /rɪˈvɜːt/ (động từ): đưa về trạng thái trước. "Revert a commit" = tạo commit đảo ngược thay đổi trước đó.
items.explanationEn: revert /rɪˈvɜːt/ (verb): to return to a previous state. "Revert a commit" means making a new commit that reverses an earlier change.

items.question: Trong câu "DR — a fresh cluster converges to the repo state.", từ "converge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DR — a fresh cluster converges to the repo state.", what does "converge" (verb) mean?
options: dần đạt tới cùng một trạng thái
items.explanation: converge /kənˈvɜːdʒ/ (động từ): dần đạt tới cùng một trạng thái. Trái nghĩa "diverge"; hệ thống "converge" khi cuối cùng khớp với trạng thái mong muốn.
items.explanationEn: converge /kənˈvɜːdʒ/ (verb): to move toward one state. Opposite: "diverge"; a system converges when it ends up matching the desired state.

items.question: Trong câu "Caveats: no plaintext secrets in Git (Sealed Secrets, SOPS, External Secrets Operator); imperative steps like migrations need sync hooks or Jobs; many apps × clusters need structure to stay readable.", từ "caveat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Caveats: no plaintext secrets in Git (Sealed Secrets, SOPS, External Secrets Operator); imperative steps like migrations need sync hooks or Jobs; many apps × clusters need structure to stay readable.", what does "caveat" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: caveat /ˈkæviæt/ (danh từ): lưu ý, hạn chế. "With one caveat" = với một lưu ý; dùng khi nêu điều kiện hoặc giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: caveat /ˈkæviæt/ (noun): a warning or limitation. "With one caveat" introduces a condition or limitation.

items.question: Trong câu "Caveats: no plaintext secrets in Git (Sealed Secrets, SOPS, External Secrets Operator); imperative steps like migrations need sync hooks or Jobs; many apps × clusters need structure to stay readable.", từ "imperative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Caveats: no plaintext secrets in Git (Sealed Secrets, SOPS, External Secrets Operator); imperative steps like migrations need sync hooks or Jobs; many apps × clusters need structure to stay readable.", what does "imperative" (adjective) mean?
options: dạng lệnh thực hiện từng bước
items.explanation: imperative /ɪmˈperətɪv/ (tính từ): dạng lệnh thực hiện từng bước. "Imperative" (ra lệnh làm gì) đối lập với "declarative" (mô tả kết quả mong muốn).
items.explanationEn: imperative /ɪmˈperətɪv/ (adjective): done as explicit commands. "Imperative" (say what to do) contrasts with "declarative" (describe the result).

items.question: Trong câu "Both are CNCF graduated projects for pull-based GitOps on Kubernetes.", từ "graduated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are CNCF graduated projects for pull-based GitOps on Kubernetes.", what does "graduated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: graduated /ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪd/ (tính từ): đã đạt mức trưởng thành. CNCF xếp dự án theo cấp: sandbox → incubating → graduated (trưởng thành nhất).
items.explanationEn: graduated /ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪd/ (adjective): having reached full maturity. CNCF ranks projects as sandbox, incubating, then graduated (the most mature).

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: a visual control plane for many teams and clusters → Argo CD; a lightweight, fully declarative per-cluster toolkit → Flux.", từ "lightweight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: a visual control plane for many teams and clusters → Argo CD; a lightweight, fully declarative per-cluster toolkit → Flux.", what does "lightweight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lightweight /ˈlaɪtweɪt/ (tính từ): gọn nhẹ. "Lightweight tool" = công cụ ít phụ thuộc, tốn ít tài nguyên.
items.explanationEn: lightweight /ˈlaɪtweɪt/ (adjective): small and simple to run. A "lightweight tool" has few dependencies and uses few resources.

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: a visual control plane for many teams and clusters → Argo CD; a lightweight, fully declarative per-cluster toolkit → Flux.", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: a visual control plane for many teams and clusters → Argo CD; a lightweight, fully declarative per-cluster toolkit → Flux.", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "As a rule of thumb" = theo kinh nghiệm chung, không phải quy tắc tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical rough guide. "As a rule of thumb" means as a general guide, not a strict rule.

items.question: Trong câu "DORA research (DevOps Research and Assessment, now at Google Cloud) found that a few metrics predict delivery performance, and that speed and stability improve together.", từ "predict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DORA research (DevOps Research and Assessment, now at Google Cloud) found that a few metrics predict delivery performance, and that speed and stability improve together.", what does "predict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: predict /prɪˈdɪkt/ (động từ): dự báo. Danh từ "prediction"; tính từ "predictable" = có thể đoán trước.
items.explanationEn: predict /prɪˈdɪkt/ (verb): to say what will happen. The noun is "prediction"; "predictable" means able to be foreseen.

items.question: Trong câu "DORA research (DevOps Research and Assessment, now at Google Cloud) found that a few metrics predict delivery performance, and that speed and stability improve together.", từ "assessment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DORA research (DevOps Research and Assessment, now at Google Cloud) found that a few metrics predict delivery performance, and that speed and stability improve together.", what does "assessment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assessment /əˈsesmənt/ (danh từ): sự đánh giá. Động từ "assess"; "risk assessment" = đánh giá rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: assessment /əˈsesmənt/ (noun): the act of judging. The verb is "assess"; a "risk assessment" judges risks.

items.question: Trong câu "DORA research (DevOps Research and Assessment, now at Google Cloud) found that a few metrics predict delivery performance, and that speed and stability improve together.", từ "stability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DORA research (DevOps Research and Assessment, now at Google Cloud) found that a few metrics predict delivery performance, and that speed and stability improve together.", what does "stability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stability /stəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): độ ổn định. Tính từ "stable"; DORA cho thấy tốc độ và độ ổn định cùng tăng.
items.explanationEn: stability /stəˈbɪləti/ (noun): steadiness. The adjective is "stable"; DORA found speed and stability rise together.

items.question: Trong câu "What % of deployments need remediation (rollback, hotfix)?", từ "remediation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What % of deployments need remediation (rollback, hotfix)?", what does "remediation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of fixing a problem
items.explanation: remediation /rɪˌmiːdiˈeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự khắc phục. Động từ "remediate"; hay gặp "vulnerability remediation" = khắc phục lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: remediation /rɪˌmiːdiˈeɪʃn/ (noun): the act of fixing a problem. The verb is "remediate"; "vulnerability remediation" means fixing security holes.

items.question: Trong câu "Recent reports add rework rate (unplanned deployments to fix user-facing issues).", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recent reports add rework rate (unplanned deployments to fix user-facing issues).", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriːwɜːk/ (danh từ): việc phải làm lại. "Rework" là công sức bỏ ra để sửa những gì đã làm chưa đúng.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriːwɜːk/ (noun): work done again to fix. "Rework" is the effort spent fixing work that was not right.

items.question: Trong câu "Recent reports add rework rate (unplanned deployments to fix user-facing issues).", từ "unplanned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recent reports add rework rate (unplanned deployments to fix user-facing issues).", what does "unplanned" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unplanned /ˌʌnˈplænd/ (tính từ): ngoài kế hoạch. "Unplanned downtime/work" = ngừng hoạt động hoặc công việc phát sinh bất ngờ.
items.explanationEn: unplanned /ˌʌnˈplænd/ (adjective): not arranged beforehand. "Unplanned downtime/work" is downtime or work that arises unexpectedly.

items.question: Trong câu "Top performers deploy on demand, many times a day, with lead and recovery times in hours or less.", từ "on demand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Top performers deploy on demand, many times a day, with lead and recovery times in hours or less.", what does "on demand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on demand /ˌɒn dɪˈmɑːnd/ (cụm từ): bất cứ khi nào cần. "On-demand" (tính từ) cũng gặp trong "on-demand instances" = dùng khi cần.
items.explanationEn: on demand /ˌɒn dɪˈmɑːnd/ (phrase): whenever needed. As an adjective, "on-demand" appears in "on-demand instances", used whenever needed.

items.question: Trong câu "How this topic moves them: small batches and automated pipelines → frequency and lead time; canary, flags, expand–contract → lower failure rate; fast rollback and kill switches → faster recovery.", từ "batch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How this topic moves them: small batches and automated pipelines → frequency and lead time; canary, flags, expand–contract → lower failure rate; fast rollback and kill switches → faster recovery.", what does "batch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an amount of food baked at once
items.explanation: batch /bætʃ/ (danh từ): lô, đợt xử lý chung. "Small batches" = mỗi lần triển khai ít thay đổi, dễ kiểm tra và quay lui.
items.explanationEn: batch /bætʃ/ (noun): a group handled together. "Small batches" means few changes per deploy, easier to verify and roll back.

items.question: Trong câu "Pitfalls: the metrics describe a team's system, not individuals — tie them to performance reviews and people game them.", từ "pitfall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pitfalls: the metrics describe a team's system, not individuals — tie them to performance reviews and people game them.", what does "pitfall" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ (danh từ): sai lầm dễ mắc. "Avoid common pitfalls" = tránh các sai lầm hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ (noun): a common hidden mistake. "Avoid common pitfalls" means steering clear of frequent mistakes.

items.question: Trong câu "Pitfalls: the metrics describe a team's system, not individuals — tie them to performance reviews and people game them.", từ "game" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pitfalls: the metrics describe a team's system, not individuals — tie them to performance reviews and people game them.", what does "game" (verb) mean?
options: lách để làm đẹp số liệu
items.explanation: game /ɡeɪm/ (động từ): lách để làm đẹp số liệu. "Game the metrics/system" = lợi dụng kẽ hở để chỉ số trông tốt mà thực chất không tốt.
items.explanationEn: game /ɡeɪm/ (verb): to manipulate a system unfairly. "Game the metrics/system" means exploiting loopholes so numbers look good without real improvement.

items.question: Trong câu "collect data automatically, and watch trends.", từ "trend" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "collect data automatically, and watch trends.", what does "trend" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trend /trend/ (danh từ): xu hướng biến đổi. "Watch trends" = theo dõi chiều hướng theo thời gian thay vì một con số lẻ.
items.explanationEn: trend /trend/ (noun): a general direction of change. "Watch trends" means following direction over time rather than single numbers.

items.question: Trong câu "Continuous delivery = always releasable, human decides", từ "releasable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuous delivery = always releasable, human decides", what does "releasable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: releasable /rɪˈliːsəbl/ (tính từ): sẵn sàng phát hành. Hậu tố "-able" = có thể được; "releasable" = có thể phát hành bất cứ lúc nào.
items.explanationEn: releasable /rɪˈliːsəbl/ (adjective): ready to be released. The suffix "-able" means "can be"; releasable means it can be released at any time.

items.question: Trong câu "shadow = real load, no user impact, beware side effects.", từ "beware" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "shadow = real load, no user impact, beware side effects.", what does "beware" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beware /bɪˈweə(r)/ (động từ): cẩn thận với. "Beware of something" = hãy đề phòng điều gì; thường dùng ở dạng mệnh lệnh.
items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweə(r)/ (verb): to be careful of. "Beware of something" is a warning to watch out, usually used as a command.

items.question: Trong câu "Feature flags decouple release from deploy; manage flag debt.", từ "decouple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Feature flags decouple release from deploy; manage flag debt.", what does "decouple" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decouple /diːˈkʌpl/ (động từ): tách rời. "Decouple A from B" = tách A khỏi B để chúng thay đổi độc lập; "loosely coupled" = ít phụ thuộc.
items.explanationEn: decouple /diːˈkʌpl/ (verb): to separate linked things. "Decouple A from B" lets them change independently; "loosely coupled" means weakly linked.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategies trade cost, rollback speed, mixed-version exposure and blast radius; automated canary is the modern default for busy services.", từ "trade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategies trade cost, rollback speed, mixed-version exposure and blast radius; automated canary is the modern default for busy services.", what does "trade" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to balance one thing against another
items.explanation: trade /treɪd/ (động từ): đánh đổi. "Trade A for B" / "trade-off" = hy sinh cái này để được cái kia.
items.explanationEn: trade /treɪd/ (verb): to balance one thing against another. "Trade A for B" and "trade-off" mean giving up one thing to gain another.

items.question: Trong câu "Strategies trade cost, rollback speed, mixed-version exposure and blast radius; automated canary is the modern default for busy services.", từ "default" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strategies trade cost, rollback speed, mixed-version exposure and blast radius; automated canary is the modern default for busy services.", what does "default" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (danh từ): lựa chọn mặc định. "By default" = khi không cấu hình gì khác; "safe defaults" = giá trị mặc định an toàn.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (noun): the standard choice. "By default" means when nothing else is set; "safe defaults" are safe preset values.
